SELECT p.id , p.pool_name , p.pool_type , p.market_codes , p.variety_codes , p.description , p.max_capacity , p.batch_in_flow_id , p.batch_in_flow_key , p.batch_in_flow_name , p.batch_out_flow_id , p.batch_out_flow_key , p.batch_out_flow_name FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.pool_type = 'credit_bond' AND JSON_CONTAINS(p.variety_codes, '"bond"')
AND p.id IN
#{poolId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY p.outer_sort ASC , p.inner_sort ASC , p.id ASC

SELECT si.wind_code AS securityCode , si.short_name AS securityShortName , si.security_type , si.issuer , si.issuer_code , si.full_name , si.rating_bond , si.rating_bondissuer , si.inner_issuer_rating , si.abs_flag , si.guarant_flag , si.yx_flag , si.cj_flag , si.issue_type , si.inner_class , si.inright_flag , si.std_credit_flag , si.maturity_date , si.date_exists , si.date_exists_str , si.guarantor , si.guarantor_id , si.inner_guarantor_rating FROM rrs_securityinfo si
AND si.security_type != 'company' AND si.security_status != 'D'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = si.wind_code AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_pool_status ips WHERE ips.security_code = si.wind_code AND ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 )
AND si.wind_code LIKE CONCAT(#{securityCode}, '%')
AND si.short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityShortName}, '%')
AND si.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{securityFullName}, '%')
AND si.issuer_code LIKE CONCAT(#{issuerCode}, '%')
AND si.issuer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{issuer}, '%')
AND (
( ( si.security_source = 'temporary' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM rrs_temp_security_code t WHERE t.temp_security_code = si.wind_code AND t.temp_security_market = #{marketCode} ) ) OR ( ( si.security_source IS NULL OR si.security_source != 'temporary' ) AND TRIM(si.market) = #{marketCode} ) )
)
AND COALESCE(si.guarant_flag, 0) = 1
AND COALESCE(si.inright_flag, 0) = 1
AND si.std_credit_flag = 1
AND COALESCE(si.yx_flag, 0) = 1
AND (si.issue_type LIKE CONCAT('%', '私募', '%') OR si.inner_class LIKE CONCAT('%', '私募', '%'))
AND (COALESCE(si.abs_flag, 0) = 1 OR si.security_type = 'abs')
AND COALESCE(si.cj_flag, 0) = 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.id = #{poolId} AND p.status = 'enabled' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND JSON_CONTAINS(p.variety_codes, '"bond"') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.status = 'enabled' AND child.is_deleted = 0 )

WITH source_company AS ( SELECT company.wind_code AS company_code , MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(company.full_name, ''), NULLIF(company.short_names, ''))) AS company_name FROM ais_inv_analysis.t_inv_company company
AND company.wind_code IS NOT NULL AND company.wind_code != '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(company.full_name, ''), NULLIF(company.short_names, '')) IS NOT NULL
AND company.wind_code LIKE CONCAT(#{companyCode}, '%')
AND (company.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%') OR company.short_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%'))
GROUP BY company.wind_code )
, ranked_grade AS ( SELECT grade.windcode , grade.windname , grade.total_score , grade.ts , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY grade.windcode ORDER BY grade.ts DESC ) AS row_num FROM ais_inv_analysis.v_inv_grade_result grade WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_company company WHERE company.company_code = grade.windcode ) )
, ranked_outer_rating AS ( SELECT rating.s_info_compcode , rating.b_info_creditrating , rating.b_info_creditratingagency , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rating.s_info_compcode ORDER BY rating.ann_dt DESC , rating.opdate DESC , rating.object_id DESC ) AS row_num FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondissuerrating rating WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dict_external_rating_agency agency WHERE agency.is_deleted = 0 AND agency.b_info_creditratingagency = rating.b_info_creditratingagency ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source_company candidate WHERE candidate.company_code = rating.s_info_compcode ) )
SELECT company.company_code , COALESCE(grade.windname, company.company_name) AS company_name , grade.total_score AS inner_rating , grade.ts AS rating_time , outer_rating.b_info_creditrating AS rating_bondissuer , outer_rating.b_info_creditratingagency AS rating_bondissuer_agency FROM source_company company LEFT JOIN ranked_grade grade ON grade.windcode = company.company_code AND grade.row_num = 1 LEFT JOIN ranked_outer_rating outer_rating ON outer_rating.s_info_compcode = company.company_code AND outer_rating.row_num = 1 ORDER BY company.company_code ASC
